policies.E0: reference: constant 100 % target, no stop at all (T100 of v1.3 with the peak stop disabled); gate blind to the global risk_off
policies.E1: reference: the current mechanism, exactly T100 of v1.3 — 10 % peak stop armed in transition, line barred until a confirmed trend_up or reversal_up; gate blind to the global risk_off
policies.TC44: reference: constant 44.226403 % target, the rules of protocol v1.3 (stop, re-entry, gate seeing the global risk_off)
policies.S1: candidate: an asset is held while its daily close is strictly above its 200-day mean, out otherwise
policies.S2: candidate: S1 with hysteresis — out under 97 % of the 200-day mean, back in only above 103 %
policies.S3: candidate: out at a daily close <= 80 % of the highest daily close since the entry was filled; back in when the daily close re-crosses above its 50-day mean
policies.S4: candidate: S3, with at least 10 days out of the market before any rebuy
policies.S5: candidate: the synthetic basket index (32.5/32.5/20/15, rebalanced daily, close-to-close) with S2 hysteresis on its 200-day mean — all four assets out or in together

text: eliminated: continuous drawdown above 50 % (on 4h close equity, from the trajectory high)
eliminated: fees plus slippage, cumulated in dollars over the window, above half of E1's
among the rest, the best annualised net return; a candidate strictly less than 3 annualised points behind the best is preferred if simpler, in the order S1, S5, S2, S3, S4

none left: nothing goes to validation, no sealed opening, no production change; neither the thresholds nor the 50 % limit change after the results; any new attempt is a new pre-registered experiment (A2)

bootstrap_method.series: daily log-return difference, candidate minus comparator, on the development window
bootstrap_method.block_length: Politis-White mean block length per comparison, computed on the development window by the development run and published there; frozen with the candidate before any opening of the sealed window
bootstrap_method.method: stationary bootstrap (Politis and Romano), circular, geometric blocks

verdict_rules_for_a_later_sealed_validat: admissibility first: continuous drawdown <= 50 % for the candidate and each comparator; a non-admissible comparator is published but does not enter the verdict
preuve forte: candidate admissible, at least 5 annualised net points ahead of the best admissible comparator, bootstrap lower bound positive against it
avantage pratique: candidate admissible, at least 5 points ahead of the best admissible comparator, interval including zero
viable sans comparateur admissible: candidate admissible, no admissible comparator
non retenue: candidate not admissible, or less than 5 points ahead of the best admissible comparator
